description: Recover a film after an uncertain or interrupted result: reads the original generationId, or the exact approved projectId and revision through free read-only discovery. Preserve the original quoteId; never select a newer revision or repeat soclo_video_make. Continue normal free status reads until the response returns one Open finished film link and its immutable Library/hash/byte identity; return that link in this same chat. The same link is recoverable after disconnection. Free; changes nothing.

generationId.description: The original generationId returned by soclo_video_make. Recovery can instead use the exact approved projectId and revision; no newer revision is selected.

projectId.description: The approved projectId from soclo_quote. With revision, finds the film when the generationId is not held.

quoteId.description: The original quoteId from soclo_quote; preserve it when known.

revision.description: The approved revision from soclo_quote. Never substitute a newer revision.

name: soclo_video_recover
title: Recover a finished film link
